title: Ceiling bound for the Braverman parameter
statement: Let $m,d$ be natural numbers and let $\varepsilon,c\in\mathbb{R}$ satisfy $m\geq1$, $0<\varepsilon\leq1$, and $c>0$. Set $B=\log(m/\varepsilon)+2$, $E=cd$, and $k=\lceil B^E\rceil$. Then $k\leq B^{(c+1)d}$.
